## Review triage

The PR author did this triage. Reviewed at `0460f61`; the fix is `a838d3d`.

| Reviewer | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| PR-Agent | Brittle parsing: `frontmatterRelated` reads only the inline double-quoted form | **Applied** in `a838d3d`. Any other form of `related` now throws a parser error, instead of failing later as a rendering mismatch. Checked by rewriting a note as a block sequence: the test fails with `this test reads related only as an inline list of double-quoted ids`. |
| PR-Agent | Silent skip when `dist/` is missing | **Declined.** CI builds before `npm test`, and the check ran on this PR: `ok 456 - every published note page renders its related notes…`. The skip follows the same convention as `nginx-cache.test.mjs`, so unit-only local runs still work. |
| PR-Agent | DoD (a): claims without command output | **Applied.** The PR body now has an Evidence section with the CI TAP lines and the failing-build error. |
| PR-Agent | DoD (b): the `related` convention is documented only in code | **Declined.** The schema in `content.config.ts` is where note authors find every frontmatter field (`tags`, `draft`, …), and no doc under `docs/` lists them. The resolver's error message names the rule when it is broken. |
| PR-Agent | SDD: no spec | **Declined.** The plan is the ticket's acceptance criteria plus the related table approved there, before any code was written. The change is one optional field, one block and one build-time check; a spec would restate the ticket. |
| CodeRabbit | Review still processing, no findings posted | Not reviewed. Declared here; no nudge. |

CI is green on `0460f61`. Checks are re-running on `a838d3d`.

The probe talks to a container on `localhost` in the same job, not over a network, and a stack trace there is as clear a failure as the old message |

| CI | green | every required check passes on `6ae3bc64ca8e` |

## Review triage

The PR author did this triage, at `e62e441`.

| Source | Finding | Disposition |
|---|---|---|
| CI | All checks green at `e62e441`, including `PR gate`, `Validate build` (the new `Trivy gate on CRITICAL` step ran and passed on this image) and `review` | none needed |
| PR-Agent | Gate fails on scanner outage; the claim that the database is shared is unbacked | declined, with the claim corrected in `e62e441`. The gate fails closed on purpose: a gate that passes when it cannot scan is not a gate. The sharing is now stated from evidence: the job log of `cbd53e7` shows both Trivy steps with `cache-dir: .cache/trivy` and both restoring `cache-trivy-2026-11-11` from the Actions cache, so the gate downloads no database, and it scans an image already in the runner's docker. The residual exposure is a day's first build hitting a feed outage, which fails the report scan's download first |
| PR-Agent | Order assertion passes vacuously if the upload step is renamed | applied in `e62e441`: the check now requires the upload step to exist |
| PR-Agent | AC1 not in this diff; AC2 not verifiable from code | no change needed: AC1 landed in WEB-119's earlier PR (the scan has had no `if:` since then, and the test asserts it); the AC2 baseline is the 2026-11-06 comment on the ticket (1 CRITICAL and 6 HIGH on the old digest, 0 on the current one) |
| CodeRabbit | No review on this PR | no review ran; declared |
